summary.text: Laalitya Acharya is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 56 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Adam Mathews.
She is an engineering manager who, in a Ballotpedia survey, named public education, affordability and health care as her main campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Laalitya Acharya graduated from William Mason High School and earned a bachelor's and a graduate degree from Columbia University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her parents immigrated from India to Ohio, and that her degrees were in biomedical engineering.
Her career experience includes working as an engineering manager, and she said she works in clinical research.
Acharya said she returned to the district after graduate school and organized in 2023 against a legislative proposal to raise the threshold for passing citizen-led ballot initiatives to 60 percent.
She said she is not accepting corporate PAC or dark money contributions.
Her stated priorities include ending school vouchers, universal pre-K, a living wage, and greater transparency from health insurers.
Acharya advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
